news.title: Spain vs England: Tuchel eager to end unbeaten run of FIFA World Cup and Euro winner in Madrid
news.lede: London Thomas Tuchel believes England is ready to end Spain’s unbeaten record when its face the world and European champion in Madrid on Sunday. While victory offers not much more than the prospect of a more favourable Nations League quarterfinal in March, it would be a landmark moment for England if it could end Spain’s run of 43 matches without defeat. “It (Spain) is a team that has forgotten how to lose, so of course it requires a top performance first of all, and if we can deliver this performance, it will give us a big boost,” said England manager Tuchel, whose side beat Croatia 2-1 at Wembley on Thursday. “I think we’re there, and I think we’re ready to win on Sunday,” the German added.

news.title: Ronaldinho to Start in Official Football Match After Decade
news.lede: Brazil's World Cup winner and great footballer Ronaldinho is set to take the field from the starting lineup in an official football match for the first time in more than a decade. The 46-year-old former Barcelona and AC Milan playmaker will be seen on the field when Ravenna faces local rivals Forlì on Sunday in Italy's third division (Serie C) league. This will be his first participation since joining this club last August. Before this, he last played an official match for Brazilian club Fluminense in September 2015.

news.title: Women's National Football Team to Play Away Friendlies Against Catalonia and Belgium in Preparation for World Cup
news.lede: ▲ Head Coach Shin Sang-woo The South Korean women's national football team is heading to Spain for an away trip in preparation for the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup in Brazil. The Korea Football Association announced that the women's national team, led by head coach Shin Sang-woo, will hold a training camp in Catalonia, Spain, from November 24 to December 3. The national team will utilize the FIFA-designated women's international match window in November and December to train locally and play two friendly matches. The first match will take place against the Catalonia representative team at 8:00 PM on November 28 at Estadi Municipal Narcís Sala in Barcelona.
